balls.text: he works it towards Katich at deep square leg and they risk the second run, Rao is run out by a mile, Sanga whips off the bails
pushes it to sweeper cover
may have been a bit harsh, he bowls the slower bouncer short outside off, Symonds walks down the pitch and the ball just sails over his helmet
forces a full delivery to long-off and Jayawardene fumbles a bit
exposes his stumps to a full delivery and forces it to deep cover
makes room and thumps it over the bowler's head

full and swinging in from round the wicket and Symonds makes room and forces it to long-off, they decide against the second, Rao is a little lazy in grounding his bat at his end and Sanga whips off the bails and appeals, the decision is referred
makes room again and Lee follows him by bowling it full and on the pads, he squeezes it out to midwicket
full outside off and he makes room and squeezes it out towards point
fires it full and fast outside off and Symonds makes room to dig it out but misses
he makes room and squeezes out a low full toss to long-off
bangs it in short and Rao fends it off to the on side
very hard call by saheba, Lee is unfairly penalised for a slow bouncer, Rao makes room but withdraws from the upper cut
excellent bouncer, Rao decides to go for the upper cut very late and well the ball just misses the edge
full on the stumps and he works it to deep midwicket, another expensive over
gets forward and drives to long-on
he makes room and Mota fires it full on the stumps, unfortunately for the bowler an inside edge trickles past the stumps and keeper
that's a one handed six! He makes room to a full delivery, takes his bottom hand off the handle and swings to long-on
it's a no-ball above waist height and he works it to long-on
works it to midwicket and that's his fifty! Symonds announces his arrival in style
makes room and forces it down to long-on and Jayawardene saves his team a couple of runs with a committed save at long-on
swivels and pulls off one leg straight to deep square-leg
drops it short and he swivels and biffs him across the line, the short arm pull sends the ball scorching to the deep midwicket boundary
slams it hard square of the wicket and Mota does brilliantly at deep cover to slide and cut it off just inches from the rope
Sreesanth suffers again by bowling a half volley outside off, Symonds lofts hard through the line and gets enough bat to clear the rope at long-off
he goes big, he goes half a dozen! Sreesanth bowls him a friendly half volley and he makes room and lofts him through the line and deposits it a mile over the wide long-on boundary
he drops it short and cramps the batsman for room, he settles for a single to point
angles it into the right hander and he gets a leading edge to the off side
comes round the wicket and the ball clips his pads and rolls away as he tries to work it to the on side
it's a high full toss and he only suceeds in angling it straight to short third man, Symonds had set off for the single at first
shot! He makes room to a short delivery and slaps it with savage power over long-off, boy that really travelled off the bat
makes room and  whacks a full delivery over the bowler's head, the ball travels like a bullet and just drops in front of the rope, the umpire checks upstairs
clips it with soft hands towards short midwicket and Irfan turns around and has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end, direct hit would have sent him back
works it to midwicket for a couple
shot! He drops it a bit short and he rocks backwards and biffs it over midwicket with a short arm pull
short and wide and the ball stops on him and he reaches out and slashes it high in the air, the ball drops short of sweeper cover
the googly really skids through and he adjusts well by hitting it to the off side against the turn
turns and grips the surface and Symonds gets a leading edge to cover
gets forward and pushes it to cover
gives him width and he pushes it hard to extra cover
plays the on drive and pushes it to long-on
it's a low full toss and he works it to deep midwicket
the ball stops on him and he pushes it straight to mid-on
goes for the cut but he swings at thin air, too early onto the shot
fullish and driven hard down to long-on
makes room and drives to extra cover
lovely shot to relieve the pressure! He chips down the track and lofts inside out with the spin and clears the boundary at deep extra cover
makes room and chops it down to cover point
pushed towards the off side
Dropped Slammed really hard back to Yuvraj and he palms it away towards the straight boundary
goes for the straight loft and two fielders converge at the boundary to save it
full on middle and leg and he works it to midwicket
shuffles and clips it to short fine leg and Yuvraj gets a bad bounce
bashes it hard on the front foot and Chawla makes up for his earlier lapses with a sharp save at cover
fires it full and Symonds jams it back to the bowler
the offcutter and Symonds tucks it softly to the on side
short of a length and Symonds checks his shot and nearly chips it on the full toYuvraj at midwicket
another short ball stops short on the batsman and he manages to fend it off
full outside off and he steers it to the off side

Doesn't take Lee too long to see the back of Sharma! He bowls another slower delivery and drops it short and angles it down the leg side, Sharma swivels to pull but the ball lobs off the bottom half of the bat and dips to Sanga who falls forward and takes the catch, the umpire Saheba consults Baxter if the catch is taken cleanly but Sharma walks

Lee's sharp and quick! He bowls the slow bouncer to Symonds who fends it off and drops the ball in front of the stumps, they go through with the run and Lee athletically dives and underarms the ball onto the stumps, the decision goes upstairs
clips it towards short leg and thinks of a cheeky single but Lee charges down and fields it himself
almost a first baller for Symonds! The ball just angles away off the seam and beats his hopeful prod
turns the face of the bat and gets off the mark with a gentle push to long-on
gets width and he reaches out and drives to deep cover
pushes it hard to mid-on
stays back and punches it hard to mid-off

Suman stays at the crease and looks to play the stylish whip over long leg but the ball lands down Jayawardene's throat in that position, he takes it at the edge of the boundary while running to his left
checks his shot as he pushes it to mid-on
drops it a bit short and the ball comes on a bit slowly, enough time for him to rock back and pull over midwicket
chips down the track but checks his shot and the ball clips his pads and rolls away
pushes it past the covers
gives it a bit more air and Suman chips down the track and shapes to loft straight but it doesn;t matter as he gets enough elevation to clear long-off by a mile
stays back and punches him on the up to long-on
Rohit gets across to flick him away to the on side but he checks his shot and flicks him uppishly to mid-on, the fielder was deep
bowls it on a good length and straight and Suman steers it hard to point
drops it in front of cover and the pair set off easily for the single
punches it just wide of Sreesanth who dives to his right
delivers from slightly wide of the crease and the batsman covers the line well and pushes it to the off side
lands it on middle and off and he punches it hard down the track
really sharp spinning googly and he clips it with the turn to midwicket
fetches it from outside off and pushes it to midwicket
the googly, he gets forward and defends

he bowls it a touch too wide outside the offstump and Gibbs rocks back and shapes to slap it hard past point but he plays on the up and Jayawardene just manages to hang on with a diving catch to his left
stays back and punches it against the turn to mid-on
makes room and Chawla drops it short, he swivels and pulls straight to deep midwicket, slight fumble but it doesn't cost an extra run
he bowls a half volley on middle and leg and he gets across his stumps and whips him stylishly past midwicket, Lee gives the chase and pulls it back
steps down the track and checks his shot to mid-on on seeing Sreesanth drop the ball short
gives him width and he steers it to deep backward point
plays a stylish offdrive and the fielder at cover finally sets a good example on the field by diving to his right
goes for a wild slog and the ball clips the outside edge and skies towards third man, the fielder was square
steers it towards point and Gibbs sends him back
the misfield epidemic spreads to the captain himself, Yuvraj fails to get his body down properly to collect it at mid-off, what's happening?
checks his drive to mid-off and sets off
edged and just wide of Sangakkara's right, good attempt and Katich does well to run across from third man and mop up
stylish stuff from Suman, swings it on the pads and he stays at the crease, flicks his wrists and whips him over long  leg
hits him on the pads down the leg side and outside the line of the legstump
full and wide outside off and he reaches out and doesn't get the timing or distance for the loft, Yuvraj runs backwards from mid-off and tries to take a diving catch
gets it to come back in and Gibbs is cramped for room, he gets a thick inside edge
lands it outside off and he safely shoulders arms
relief for Sreesanth, he swings it towards the pads and Gilchrist follows the movement and flicks him on the up, it's a flat hit straight to Powar who makes no mistake at long leg
he gets some late inswing and Gilchrist goes for the flick a little too early and the ball hits his pads again
swings early and the ball clips his pads and rolls away down the pitch
poor start for Sreesanth, he digs it in short and Gilchrist swivels early and pulls him over deep square-leg, Sreesanth's not having a good time against former Australian openers
bowls it outside off and Gibbs swings blindly and misses
misfield again and Chawla's having a nightmare already, he drives hard to cover but I think Chawla can blame the bad bounce for this one
chips down the track early and then checks his loft on spotting the change of pace, nevertheless the ball plonks in the middle of nowhere wide of mid-on
Free Hit: Well bowled Brett, he bowls the slower bouncer and Gibbs makes room to whack but swings at thin air instead
he oversteps and the batsman drives hard on the front foot and places it just wide of mid-off
goes for a big swish outside the offstump and misses it completely as the ball kicks up and then angles inwards
checks his drive and pushes it uppishly towards mid-on
misfield! Gilchrist cuts hard away from the body and Chawla makes a mess of it at cover, did he get a bad bounce?
edged and it didn't carry! The ball swings away, clips the outside edge and the ball just drops in front of Jayawardene at slip
he feeds him with width and it's raw power from Gilchrist as he reaches put and slams it in the small window between cover point and backward point
full swinging away and he plays a checked drive towards cover
shuffles and clips it down to fine leg and sets off
drops it in front of mid-off and Gilchrist stops halfway down the pitch and makes his ground
lands it full on middle and off and he pushes it to mid-on
loosener and well put away, short and wide outside off and Gilchrist reaches out and flashes it square of third man, the men at the Punjab dug out do the honours
138.6 kph, bangs it in short and wide outside off and he lets it go
142.4 kph, keeps the speed consistent and this time he lands it a touch wider and still tempts Gilchrist to drive, another edge missed
142.2 kph, the speed says it all, he lands it full and gets Gilchrist to play a swishy drive and the ball just beats the edge
hits on target outside off, not at full pace, Gilchrist opts to let it go
that's it! Angles it on the pads and he clips it on the up just wide of short mid-on's reach, Lee leaps and the Punjab camp is a picture of relief
drops it on a length outside off and Lee reaches out and slaps it down to long-off and pushes hard for the second run
a little slower and Lee doesn't pick it and swishes at thin air, man that was close to the offstump
clips it very close to the pads and they take a single, where are the yorkers?
that's four runs less! RP bangs it in short and that too down the leg side so it allows a free swing of the arms, he hooks it just in front of the rope at fine leg
full outside off and he smashes it to deep extra cover
full toss pushed to the covers
brute power! Pitched up outside off and Lee gets under the bounce and gives it a flat thwack over long-off's reach, it seemed like it would land down the fielder's throat but he got enough elevation
it's a low full toss from round the wicket and Ojha over-runs it at cover but just manages to get some hand on it
full on the stump and he bashes it down the ground to long-off
yorker on the pads and he nearly falls over on the shot
forces it hard down the pitch to long -on

he gets width and cuts to sweeper cover, he turns around for the second run and he's struggling to make his ground, the throw from Teja is flat and quick and Gilchrist whips off the woodwork, the batsman is short of his crease and the decision goes upstairs
pushes it wide outside off and wide called
forces a full delivery hard to long-on
gets on his knee and sweeps again
he looks unstoppable! He gets on his knee and swats it in the air and bisects the big gap at deep square leg
makes room and gets a thick edge which goes to short fine leg
will this over be the turning point? Tossed up on middle and leg, he chips down the track and deposits him over long-on, 12 precious runs indeed
that's a pressure relieving six! Flighted on middle and leg and he gets on his knee and tonks him over deep midwicket, it was a front foot pull
makes room and forces him down to long-on
pushed to square leg

steps down and forces it to long-on, they take the first run but there's hesitation for the second run, Jayawardene doesn't want it but Mota is already halfway down the pitch, the throw is to the keeper's end and Gilly whips off the bails
rocks back and cuts to sweeper cover
gets forward and works it to deep midwicket
sweeps him again and he spoons it in the air for a while but the ball lands safe of fine leg
works it to deep midwicket
gets on his knee and sweeps him
spins, grips and beats him completely, classic left-arm spinner's delivery
stays back and works him against the turn to midwicket
gets forward and pushes him to long-on
stays back and nearly punches it on the full back to the bowler
worked with the turn to the on side
cuts hard square of the wicket but he finds a sharp Rohit Sharma at cover point who slides

nice catch! Irfan steps down the track and tries to mow him against the turn, Suman cuts back on the pace and a desperate heave finds the thick edge and Shoaib charges to his right and takes it falling forward
makes a lot of room and slaps him to sweeper cover
nudged to the on side, just 4 off that over
rocks back and slaps it straight to RP Singh at cover point
chips it in the air to the vacant midwicket region
defends with a dead bat back to the bowler
clips it with the turn to the on side
stays back and punches to the off side
tries to get cheeky by dabbing it late to point but he's beaten for pace
full outside off and he pushes it down to cover point
just checks his shot and softly pushes it down to long-on
drops it on a good length outside off and he cuts straight to the sweeper cover
punches it hard down the ground to long-off
drops it short and jayawardene gets in position early for the hoick, gets on top of the bounce and bangs it over deep midwicket
pulls it to short midwicket for a single
he clips it to midwicket and there;s a lot of hesitation, Irfan runs across the pitch and a direct hit would have sent him back
full on middle and leg, he drives to long-on
tucked to midwicket for a single
gets on his knee too early for the sweep and the ball clips his pads a rolls away
it's a half volley wide of the offstump and he drives him down the carpet and beats cover, the fielder at the deep dives in vain
strays on the pads and he clips it away to Shoaib at fine leg
angles it on the pads and he works it to the on side
slides down the legside and he shaops to pull and the ball clips his body and just beats Gilchrist's reach
he gets superb away swing which just beats the outside edge, excellent delivery
very nearly wicket No.5! Irfan prods forward to a ball which just stops on him and he nearly chips it on the full to short cover

at the stroke of the strategy break! Yuvraj swings across the line and goes for broke and he gets a thick top edge and the ball swirls to Gilchrist who takes the skier and that sparks off wild celebrations
short and wide and he slashes hard to third man

Sangakkara gets too cheeky and gives it all away! Shoaib comes round the wicket and bowls it full and angles it in, Sanga moves a long way across his stumps, gets on his knee and tries to paddle it away but the ball clips the edge and cannons onto his legstump
wide again and this time he kneels down and scoops him over point and Harris has a lot of work to do at sweeper cover
too wide outside off and he reaches out and cuts to the sweeper cover
drops it a bit short and he swivels and pulls him to deep midwicket
flighted down the leg side and Sangakkara gets on his knee and sweeps hard and it's hit with so much power that Shoaib is really hurried into the dive at fine leg
down the leg side and he tries to sweep it away
hard and flat! Sanga picks the flight and length very early as he gets on his knee and biffs him savagely over deep midwicket
gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to midwicket
pushes it to midwicket
one of the cleanest hits you'd see and it's out of the ground! Symonds flights it on middle and Yuvraj makes room and scoops him high through the line, dead straight six
flighted on middle and off and he clips it to midwicket
gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler
pushed towards mid-on
not short enough to pull but he gets forward and forces it to the on side
kneels down and mows it to short fine leg
pushed hard back to the bowler
chipped in the air but well short of long-on, he puts pressure on the fielder but a slack effort costs a second run
drifts on the pads and Yuvraj gets on his knee early and sweeps hard and bisects the big gap at fine leg, that scorched to the boundary
gets forward and then pushes back and cuts hard to the sweeper
gets forward and clips it to the on side, they need boundaries
flighted on middle and off and he pushes it hard to long-on
rocks back and cuts hard to sweeper cover
gets forward and drives to deep midwicket
pulls it away to the on side
clips it to the  on side
shuffles and clips it to the on side
Dropped Tough one! He scoops it hard to Rao's right and he flings himself and attempts the catch mid-air, the ball lobs off his fingers
lands it on middle and off and he gets behind the line and defends

Sharma's on a wicket-taking spree! Katich makes room and tries to loft him downtown but the ball straightens after pitching and Katich fails to get the elevation, Rao runs forward from long-on and takes the catch
flighted on middle and leg and he works it to the on side
very soft dismissal! Sohal makes a bit of room and tries to loft him straight but instead he goes inside out and gets a tame top edge down Rao's throat at mid-off
gets on his knee and sweeps to the on side
slides it down the leg side and he paddles it to fine leg
lands it on a full length and he makes room and hits inside out and bisects the gap at cover again, good start for Punjab
it's a full toss this time and Sohal reaches out and checks his shot a bit but manages to bisect the gap at the covers with ease
keeps it full and quick and Sohal makes room and swings, the ball just sneaks past his offstump
fires a quick yorker outside off and Sohal after backing away fails to make contact
gives himself room and flat bats a delivery angling into him to midwicket
drops it short and he swings early and the ball clips his body and rolls away to the on side
he makes room and the bowler follows him by pitching it up on the body, Sohal enjoys a free swing of the arms and hoicks him over fine leg
moves along way across his stumps and cuts to third man
the ball lands outside off and Katich is nowhere near the pitch of the ball as he attempts a wild slog
clips it down to fine leg
drops it with soft hands in front of the crease and the ball nearly rolls back onto the stumps
shuffles across his stumps and clips it down to square leg
Sohal has width again outside the offstump to free his arms but he keeps it down and slaps it wide of cover
knocks it to square leg for a single
gets back and across and makes use of the width to slash it to deep backward point, third man is square
was that a drop? He cuts close to his body and the ball appears to dip and drop kin front of the fielder at gully
he drops it too short and too wide and he frees his arms and plays an upper cut over backward point, poor ball and well put away
shapes to cut but he keeps it down and gets a thick edge which bisects the gap between second slip and gully, safe shot in the end
full outside off and he drives him down to deep cover
gets beside the line and pushes it down to point
full outside off and pushes it away to mid-off
nice innovation! He shuffles a long way across his stumps and whips him away to the vacant spaces at fine leg
gets across and squeezes a full delivery back to the bowler
cuts on the up and the ball beats gully, Sohal has had a tough time with the bat in the few opportunities he has got
fishes at it outside off and the ball swings away significantly
